explanation: A robot repeatedly searching for the same object category (e.g. 'find the cup' every frame while navigating) issues the same text prompt across many frames. Re-tokenizing and re-running the text transformer for an unchanged prompt string is redundant work: the resulting text embedding is deterministic given the same model weights, revision, device and dtype. Caching it once and reusing it removes the language branch from the per-frame critical path, leaving only image-side work (preprocess + vision TRT + matching) in the steady-state loop.
